ops.text: An in-process teammate cannot use ccx vcs ship's CI watch: hooks cap a teammate's foreground Bash at 60s and refuse run_in_background and chained sleeps, so the lane shipped with --no-watch and hand-polled gh api runs/<id> in repeated 55s 'timeout until' loops (CI, autobump, release). A ccx verb that blocks on a run id with a bounded --wait and re-entrant resume (e.g. ccx vcs ci wait <sha|run> --for 55s) would replace the hand loop.
